Boomio uses IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets, including title.ratings.tsv.gz, for IMDb ratings and vote counts. Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission. IMDb data is for personal and non-commercial use under IMDb terms.
Boomio uses the IntroDB API for community-provided intro, recap, credits, and preview timestamps used by skip controls. Boomio is not affiliated with or endorsed by IntroDB.
Boomio uses MDBList for ratings and external score provider data. Boomio is not affiliated with or endorsed by MDBList.

Boomio is an independent, open-source fork of Nuvio TV by Nuvio Media. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nuvio Media. Distributed under the GNU General Public License v3.0; source and license terms are available in the project repository.
Boomio TV
Boomio connects to Premiumize for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. Boomio is not affiliated with or endorsed by Premiumize.

Boomio connects to Simkl for account authentication, watchlists, watched history, playback progress, and scrobbling. Movie, TV, and anime tracking data is provided by Simkl. Boomio is not affiliated with or endorsed by Simkl.
Data providers, service credits, and Android playback licenses used by Boomio TV.

Boomio uses the TMDB API for movie and TV metadata, artwork, trailers, cast, production details, collections, and recommendations. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Boomio connects to TorBox for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. Boomio is not affiliated with or endorsed by TorBox.
Boomio connects to Trakt for account authentication, watched history, progress sync, library data, ratings, lists, and comments. Boomio is not affiliated with or endorsed by Trakt.
